title: A node can grow or shrink over time
body:
Every node lowers to an `Object` in `crates/acre/src/scene/mod.rs`. An `Object` carries `opacity: Track<f64>` and an optional `lifetime`, and nothing else that changes over time. Only a row's `origin` and its cells can move. No node can change size. The language builds no keyframes yet, since `scene::build` sets `duration` to 0, so this waits on the animation syntax in acre-4518a5.

## Proposal

- Add `scale: Track<f64>` to `Object`, so every kind of node can grow or shrink.
- `Scene::draw(t)` scales the object's primitives about an anchor point: points, sizes, stroke widths and text sizes. The renderers stay as they are, so PNG, SVG and PDF all draw it alike.

## Open

- The anchor. Leaning to the node's center by default. A file needs a way to name a corner or a side instead.
- Layout: whether a scaled node pushes its neighbours in a `stack` or a `grid`. Leaning no. Scale changes the drawing only, so a pulse does not move the page.
- Connectors: whether an arrow attached to a scaling node follows its scaled edge. Leaning yes. An arrow left on the old edge of a grown box looks broken.
- Strokes: whether an outline thickens as the node grows. Leaning yes, because text grows with the node.
- The syntax, which comes with the rest of the animation syntax.
